shortDescription: Perform device-specific operations on target devices

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: device_action
options.description: C(refresh_inventory) refreshes the inventory on the target devices. C(reset_idrac) Triggers a reset on the target iDRACs. C(clear_idrac_job_queue) Clears the job queue on the target iDRACs. A job is triggered for each action.

options.name: device_ids
options.description: IDs of the target devices. This is mutually exclusive with I(device_service_tags).

options.name: device_service_tags
options.description: Service tag of the target devices. This is mutually exclusive with I(device_ids).

options.name: hostname
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise IP address or hostname.

options.name: job_schedule
options.description: Provide the cron string to schedule the job.

options.name: job_wait
options.description: Provides an option to wait for the job completion. This option is applicable when I(state) is C(present). This is applicable when I(job_schedule) is C(startnow).

options.name: job_wait_timeout
options.description: The maximum wait time of I(job_wait) in seconds. The job is tracked only for this duration. This option is applicable when I(job_wait) is C(true).

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OME_PASSWORD=password

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) Allows to perform the I(device_action) on the target devices. C(absent) Removes the device from OpenManage Enterprise. Job is not triggered. I(job_wait), I(job_schedule), I(job_name), and I(job_description) are not applicable to this operation.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OME_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
